scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance To Small And Medium Enterprises (SME) For Raising Of Capital Through SME Exchange
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: New or existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Commercial production must have commenced between 20.05.2022 and 19.05.2027
Unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Application must be submitted within one year from the listing date on the SME Exchange
benefits_summary: 25% of the fund‑raising expenditure reimbursed, up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000.
